## About
Bill's Auto Repair started out as Mountain View Radiator. The name changed, but the ownership and the team stayed the same, and the list of services grew. Bill and Karen Herrera run it as a family business and want every customer to leave feeling like part of the family.
Bill Herrera is the owner and an A.S.E. master mechanic who lives in Santa Clara County. He has built a reputation as one of the valley's best diagnostic technicians, and every tech in the shop is trained in their specialty. If you've driven past, you've probably met Oso, our German Shepherd mascot.
Reviewers often mention Manny and the crew by name for explaining the work, keeping them informed and getting the problem fixed. We hold a 4.6 rating from 165 Google reviews.

## Services
- Factory recommended service: Keeping your car on the maker's schedule so it gets the right care at the right time.
- Computer diagnosis: Finding out what's behind a warning light or a car that just isn't running right.
- Cooling system repair: Repair work on water cooling systems for cars and trucks.
- Diesel motor repair: Maintenance and repair work on diesel motors.
- Brake and suspension repair: Brakes and suspension inspected and repaired so the car stops and handles the way it should.
- State certified smog inspection: Smog inspections done right here at the shop.
- Oil and filter changes: Regular oil and filter service to keep the engine healthy.

## FAQ
Q: Is this the same shop as Mountain View Radiator?
A: Yes. Bill's Auto Repair was formerly Mountain View Radiator, with the same ownership and the same team, plus expanded services.

Q: Do you honor extended warranties?
A: Yes, we honor extended auto warranties.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and closed on weekends.

Q: Do you work on diesel engines?
A: Yes. We offer diesel motor maintenance and repair.
